item.tib: rnal 'byor spyod pa'i sa las gzhi bsdu ba
item.coloph: rnal 'byor spyod pa'i sa las mdo sde'i gzhi bsdu pa rdzogs so/ /rgya gar gyi mkhan po pradz+nyA warma dang / dzi na mi tra dang / zhu chen gyi lo tsA ba ban+de ye shes sde la sogs pas bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa/ rnal 'byor spyod pa gzhi bsdu pa sh+lo ka drug stong brgya dgu rtsa gsum mchis so/ lan cig zhus
